messages:
Maya Patel: quick thread to scope the pinning pilot. want something small, low-risk, and measurable. propose 2 pilot tenants, paid pin for 30 days, auto-expire unless renewed. thoughts?
Alex Chen: agree small pilot. prioritize customers with stable prompt footprints. also need clear SLA options: basic (notify + manual migration) vs premium (auto-migrate + rollback guarantee).
Leila Gupta: from PM: customers worry about silent quality shifts. pilot must include an explicit "no-silent-swap" clause. any auto-migrate should be opt-in only. include detailed comms cadence.
Marco Silva: infra constraints: routing table + feature flag per-tenant easiest. DB schema change minimal. main work is audit trail + metrics tagging. estimate 1.5 devs x 3 weeks for MVP.
Maya Patel: good — include audit trail with who/when/why for every pin action. sales wants an exportable CSV for billing.
Alex Chen: on benchmarking: propose sample sizes: high-signal 200 prompts, mid 500, long-tail 1,000. use embedding-sim + task-specific proxies. report mean + 90th percentile deltas.
Leila Gupta: add human spot-checks: 20 random samples flagged if embedding-sim drops > 0.05. escalate to eng-ml for review.
Marco Silva: canary config suggestion: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 72h with automated rollback if any failure gate trips. need canary logs persisted for 90 days. OpsBot: created ticket INF-3377 for canary logging retention.
Maya Patel: pricing: recommend flat add-on + per-token uplift while pinned. keep simple for pilot: $X/mo + 1.2x token multiplier. finance to confirm pricing.
Alex Chen: product priority: rank pilot > other catalog items this sprint because legal needs real-world wording. will allocate one PM day/week to support contract drafts.
Leila Gupta: launch acceptance checklist draft: 1) bench buckets green, 2) canary ramp tested, 3) audit trail + CSV export, 4) comm templates for customers, 5) legal sign-off on T&Cs, 6) billing integration verified.
Marco Silva: ops checklist add: oncall runbook, manual force-unpin path, monitoring dashboards for pin churn, token-cost anomalies.
Maya Patel: customers asking about deprecation path: propose six-month notice + migration assistance. for pilot, shorten to 30 days but include migration incentives.
Alex Chen: compromise: pilot customers get 30d notice + one-time migration credit. good to capture feedback quickly.
Leila Gupta: documentation: add a pinned-model FAQs page: what changes when pinned, how quality measured, migration options, SLA differences, billing examples.
OpsBot: reminder: all pin actions must surface in audit log UI. link: https://redwood.internal/tools/pins (internal).
LegalEcho (bot): suggested clause: "Provider may deprecate pinned model versions with 30 days' notice; Customer may opt into auto-migrate under specified compatibility criteria. See Appendix B for compatibility tests." Need legal review checkbox.
Maya Patel: next steps: Marco create infra spike + rough timeline, Alex draft pricing + customer selection criteria, Leila draft comms + FAQ, I'll coordinate legal review + pilot outreach.
Alex Chen: tagging @sales to nominate pilots — prefer 1 mid-market and 1 enterprise.
Leila Gupta: recording decisions in roadmap ticket RD-721. will attach bench matrix and sample comms.
Marco Silva: starting spike tomorrow, will post notes in INF-3377.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone. aim to be ready for a limited pilot in 4 weeks. :rocket:
